name: crm-project-devcontainer
postCreateCommand: bash -lc "git config --global --add safe.directory /workspaces/crm-project && cd backend && poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true --local && bash -lc './scripts/install_aws_tools.sh' && poetry install --no-root"
postStartCommand: bash -lc "git config --global --add safe.directory /workspaces/crm-project && cd backend && poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true --local && (test -f .venv/pyvenv.cfg && .venv/bin/python -c 'import fastapi' >/dev/null 2>&1 || poetry install --no-root)"
